blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY, Zamboanga del Sur – The City of Isabela de Basilan marked a historic milestone on Thursday, Nov. 19, with the formal inauguration of Museo Pantán (Museum of Isabela de Basilan), its first-ever museum and the first of its kind in Southeast Asia built over water. The opening of the facility at Fuego-Fuego Beachfront in Barangay Tabiawan followed a Nov. 16 soft opening for community collaborators, key informants, and local residents.
